Agent builds go here (CI fills this folder before building the Docker image):

    simpleremote-agent-windows-amd64.exe
    simpleremote-agent-linux-amd64
    simpleremote-agent-linux-arm64
    simpleremote-agent-darwin-universal.zip

Download them from a GitHub release, or build them on each OS (see the CI workflow and scripts/build-macos-app.sh).
